owner_traces.finding: Inputs include wofost_one_day_forcing_t. Phase A maps daytime_average_temperature to daytime_mean_temperature, phase B maps forcing.average_temperature to phase_b_forcing.average_temperature; no accepted meteorological source token.

B110 runtime stores soil heat forcing and crop oxygen air_temperature input as optional model forcing; neither constitutes accepted one-day crop air-temperature receipt tied to F-KT commit.

scientific_risk: A caller can pair a truly accepted F-KT hydraulic/heat snapshot with an unrelated but plausible weather temperature. Matching lineage/revision/t0/t1 at time of sampling cannot prove the air temperature used for SWGERM=1/2 came from the same accepted forcing interval. It could silently alter germination date and subsequent crop development.
required_contract: Identify the actual atmospheric forcing owner and distinguish SWAP B1.11 tav from WOFOST phase A daytime_average_temperature and phase B average_temperature; do not equate them without source proof.

A trial-produced weather observation must bind the exact source dataset identity, physical column lineage, trial interval [t0,t1], value/units, and trial generation; rejected/retried trials must not publish observation.
The F-KT commit or already-admitted accepted window owner must atomically mint or attest the accepted meteo observation only after acceptance, including shortened accepted intervals.
For an accumulated daily tav, insist on exact contiguous coverage, no gaps/overlap, correct daily aggregation rule and no duplicate accepted interval or mixed source identities.

Bind the resulting accepted one-day tav to the same day and lineage/revision chain as certified soil head sample, with restart serialization plus anti-replay checks. The time of the sampled soil state must be explicit (day-start, day-end) and faithful to the historical B1.11 event ordering.
Gate physical germination event publication on accepted weather receipt plus existing calendar, lifecycle and F-KT accepted crop event receipt. No bypass for caller provided temperature.
negative_tests: Correct F-KT revision/time but caller substitutes different air temperature

Wrong meteorological source ID, crop-column lineage or stale F-KT revision
Swap WOFOST daytime-average and full-day-average temperatures
Restart with changed persisted tav and identical soil state

B19/MICRO root, balance and F-KT/restart frozen preservation
